articles.title: Treasury buybacks could set up Bitcoin’s next move toward $180,000, says strategist
articles.snippet: Longtime bond market investor Mark Connors sees routine government bond buybacks improving liquidity and bringing bitcoin’s next rally closer.

articles.title: US debt tops $40T stoking debate on what it means for Bitcoin
articles.snippet: Analysts say the $40 trillion debt milestone could bolster Bitcoin’s long-term case, even as Treasury yields, dollar strength and liquidity remain key near-term drivers.

articles.title: Flock's New AI Police Tool Can Track Drivers Without a Name or License Plate
articles.snippet: The underlying code for "OS Investigate" has 69 preloaded AI prompts that turn Flock cameras into a super-charged surveillance system that identifies people by how they move.
